interpretation: Bo1 series end with smaller margin than multi-map series (mean 1.00 vs 1.58, p = 0.00e+00, d = 2.58), a real format effect.

Series margin differs across tiers (F = 3.0, p = 4.84e-02, eta-sq = 0.001); the Tukey table shows which pairs differ, with tier3 the noisiest (forfeits), though variance-homogeneity is assumed, not tested (Levene skipped, car not installed).

Sweeps happen in 57.4% of decided multi-map series (n = 8825), which differs significantly from 50% (p = 6.14e-44); Wald CI [0.564, 0.584] vs prop.test's Wilson interval differ because Wilson centers differently near p far from 0.5.
